patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Crisp and LiveChat share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Crisp and LiveChat share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Crisp only if your buying job matches “Omnichannel messaging with Hugo AI — Free (2 seats); Mini $45; Essentials $95; Plus $295/w” rather than LiveChat's shape. Choose LiveChat only if your buying job matches “Established live chat from Text — Starter $19, Team $49, Business $79, Enterprise $52 per ” rather than Crisp's shape. Workflow advantage: Crisp leans ai-customer-service, omnichannel-support; LiveChat leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Crisp and LiveChat share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Crisp is Omnichannel messaging with Hugo AI — Free (2 seats); Mini $45; Essentials $95; Plus $295/workspace/mo. Primary live-chat; CS secondary.; LiveChat is Established live chat from Text — Starter $19, Team $49, Business $79, Enterprise $52 per person/mo annual. Primary live-chat; CS secondary..
- Company-size focus: Crisp (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs LiveChat (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Crisp-leaning ai-customer-service, omnichannel-support vs LiveChat-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Crisp — Hugo AI usage is credit-metered beyond included plan allotments; LiveChat — ChatBot, HelpDesk, and KnowledgeBase are separate Text suite purchases.

Limitations — Crisp: Hugo AI usage is credit-metered beyond included plan allotments; Extra seats beyond included allotment cost $10/seat/mo on paid plans; LiveChat: ChatBot, HelpDesk, and KnowledgeBase are separate Text suite purchases; No free plan — trial-only entry.

Poor-fit cases: Crisp is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Hugo AI usage is credit-metered beyond included plan allotments · LiveChat is a poor fit when that limitation bites: ChatBot, HelpDesk, and KnowledgeBase are separate Text suite purchases · Avoid Crisp if you actually need LiveChat's motion (Established live chat from Text — Starter $19, Team $49, Business $79, Enterpris)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
